method: Separate source-first final pass by the same AI operator, not a second person. Re-read the official EER component table, degree outcomes, minor/progression rules and programme/why/career evidence; re-examined enriched course profiles and actual rendered claims before comparing them with the correction conclusions. Mechanical replay is independently computed from the workbook and does not stand in for academic judgment.

sourceChecks.result: EER Appendix III B p.38 confirms all 22 Dutch Bestuurskunde components and 60+60+60 EC. Nearby MISOC is a different English-language track and is excluded.

Articles 3.3–3.6 and 4.1–4.2: approved 15-EC minor, positive BSA for year 2, completed year 1 for year 3, no year-3 enrolment in first year-2 enrolment, 135-EC thesis threshold, spring/autumn-round restrictions. These are internal context, not extra invented components. Public overview confirms ten-week second-year internship and research project.

Programme/main/why pages explicitly support social-problem, politics/law/sociology/economics, housing, crime, labour and climate applications. Formal outcomes support research and divergent-interest analysis. Rows331–340 are curricular support;343–345 are internship examples;346–356 are outcomes/further study. Four qualifications are supported:335 is inferred from Policy Analysis;347–349 are historical individual trajectories, not current professional guarantees.

Actual BENECON111 teaches micro/macro foundations, BENECON311 government spending/tax/public goods/equity, BENECON312 OLS/GLS/IV estimation and tests. The first two implement economic/public-resource study, correcting their erroneous methods-basis links in the sustainability route. Econometrics supports quantitative inquiry but is not certified as an identical EUR methods syllabus.

Actual BENLEAD311 teaches motivation, leadership, group behaviour, culture, structure and change; BENLEAD211 inclusive/diverse teams. GOSLAWJ213 explicitly covers constitutional and administrative law in five systems. EU Politics and EU Law supply different institutional/political and legal perspectives. Claims remain partial and do not imply identical Dutch public-sector training.

ENSDELT312 actually defines multi-actor governance, policy choices, enforcement and interests: a concrete limited Network Governance relationship. Living with Water covers water governance/institutions/unequal risks; Climate Change includes governance, justice and adaptation. R3 is resource stewardship, circular technologies, laboratory/inorganic chemistry; Sustainability II supplies waves, chemistry/material science and greenwashing project. Their technical contribution is explicit; neither is described as a policy-methods course. Environmental Justice supplies social-movement theory and collective-action cases.

Source-based review confirms comparative politics, international relations, political philosophy, ethics, rights, peace/conflict, sociology/theory, qualitative design and PPD as concrete public-institutions/research complements. Sociology foundations precede modern/contemporary theory. All 48 original placements, formal prerequisites and offered terms pass; 7/6 advanced courses. Same-semester Sustainability II and Governance of Sustainability is valid: the latter has no formal prerequisite and uses existing political/social foundations.

Both original organising concepts remain coherent, with 17 shared courses and seven content-justified changes. All 15 generator rows have substantive ownership. Housing/crime/labour are core public-problem applications, not manufactured specialist tracks. Individual security careers cannot generate a criminal-justice alternative. No third is needed; the stopping decision is proportionate, not a proof that all conceivable programmes are impossible.

All14 positive shared rows have concrete content-based and bounded rationales; eight unmatched components remain deliberate. General policy/policy analysis is not replaced by environmental cases; GOSPOLI312 has no offered term. Neither a research assignment nor optional UCR research is called the compulsory EUR thesis or internship. Unspecified minor is not assigned an invented subject.

Reviewed audience text matches actual curricula and distinguishes science/laboratory support, partial correspondences, specialist policy/practice gaps and optional research. Actual desktop/mobile text, source anchors, all three columns, back navigation and three course modals pass without internal notes or generic awaiting-review text.

limitations: Public official component lists and degree outcomes substantiate bounded subject-level relationships; full private EUR Osiris syllabi are not certified. The record makes no syllabus-equivalence claim.
Source URLs were retrieved again with HTTP200 and their content examined; isolated browser destination rendering is not certified.
